text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find Bamboo Memory doing squats in my office.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Forty-eight… forty-nine… fifty! I can keep going!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A student who broke the rules got away from me earlier. I can't believe something like that wore me out so much…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But I'll never let it happen again. This extra training will see to that. Plus, it doubles as a self-imposed punishment!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I have to maintain discipline at this school!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of the back-to-back races have been affecting her disciplinary committee efforts. I may need to rethink her racing schedule.
